investigations.evidenceSummary: Fresh Mobilithek/chargecloud operator inventory closes 49 ad-hoc stations / 113 AC EVSE at 0.49 EUR/kWh. Multiple current station records expose anonymous ad-hoc 0.49 EUR/kWh + 2.00 EUR start fee + 0.05 EUR/min blocking from minute 241 and credit-card access. Current first-party Ladenetz Barnim page confirms QR credit-card direct access; current first-party AGB (valid since 2025-10-01) explicitly defines Direktladen via QR/chargecloud, requires per-EVSE tariff display before purchase, and states station tariffs include statutory VAT. The first-party public price table, however, labels 0.49 EUR/kWh and blocking as emobility-card customer pricing rather than anonymous direct pricing.
